sources.fullCitation: Allan Jones, tenor, with orchestra conducted by Nathaniel Shilkret. “Cosi Cosa”, from Everybody Sing; label credit “Washington, Kaper & Jurmann”. His Master’s Voice B.8724, matrix OA.09937, 1938. Manufactured in England by The Gramophone Co. Ltd. Disc label photograph and audio transfer published by the Great 78 Project, Internet Archive.
sources.title: Cosi Cosa — His Master’s Voice B.8724
sources.creator: Allan Jones, tenor, with orchestra conducted by Nathaniel Shilkret
sources.researchNote: The Internet Archive item includes a readable photograph of the English-manufactured HMV B.8724 label. It identifies Allan Jones, Nathaniel Shilkret, matrix OA.09937 and the film Everybody Sing. SRC0783 documents the coupled side, “The One I Love”, matrix OA.09934. The film association is printed on the label and refers to this later use of the song; it does not replace the work’s earlier association with A Night at the Opera. A contemporary notice in Practical and Amateur Wireless, 7 May 1938, lists both titles on HMV B 8724; its indexed text was consulted, while the complete PDF could not be retrieved during this review. This supports the 1938 issue year, not the previously asserted session date of 13 January 1938. The issue year does not date the manufacture of the particular copy photographed.
